purpose: Resolve a named detailed material-response family and optional variant/overrides into explicit surface-behavior intent, including active subsurface, sheen, anisotropy, clear-coat, breakup, transmission, iridescence and wear-layer organs, without pretending an unverified renderer has bound them.
relationships: sits above existing texture/channel values rather than replacing them
can be retained inside whole-character material intent
provides material-behavior intent to future renderer/material pipeline bindings
limitations: Resolving a response family does not prove that any current renderer implements the active organs.
Active response organs intentionally return HOLD_RENDERER_BINDING_NOT_TESTED until a renderer earns its own evidence.
This route does not generate UVs or texture maps; existing rich-material and mesh-production paths remain separate.
Material intent is not visual acceptance.
